scope: Read-only informed qualification of four named historical entries, not morphology coding or a scored control. Supports later assessment of the four-feature instrument; does not replace any Voynich locus.
other_inventory_entries: K05–K08 remain archived with their stated gaps and different complete names; no substitution if a fixed target fails.
selection_rule: The only two complete-name pairs proposed across the two manuscripts in the frozen bounded inventory. Selection uses historical-name availability, not observed morphological agreement. Not a representative sample of known languages or herbals.
root_exposure: Expected spellings, folios, reader statements and old literature are known. Same AI informed re-reading, not a blind or independent specialist transcription.
per_target_questions: Can the visible original name be read without completing from the expected spelling? Preserve each uncertain letter and any alternative reading. Do not use modern annotations or species identification to fill it.
Is the name a heading, body naming statement, or isolated label? Keep role differences explicit. Do not remove modifiers to manufacture equality.
Which visible illustration belongs to the named entry, and where are neighboring illustrations or words? Define a candidate unit and its observable limits; no shape code or similarity judgment.
Does the source image/crop exactly match the frozen bytes, dimensions and integer rectangle? No enhanced reconstruction, new scan replacement or invented missing text.
allowed_actions: Read four provided native name crops and their complete original returned JPEGs; save source pointers, coordinates, reading uncertainty and object-scope notes. Any extra crop must use exact source pixels and be recorded. No masks or new historical text completions.
possible_later_comparison: If all four entries qualify, a separately frozen illustrative cross-manuscript entry comparison may use the same four geometry definitions. It would have two books and four leaves, body/headings rather than uniform short labels, whole plants rather than pharma fragments, a shared textual tradition, and cannot be called a matched null or an independent validation of Voynich meanings.
completion_rule: Four explicit qualification outcomes or failures. No scoring until root freezes units and a separate control contract.
